regulatory_or_exposure: EFSA CONTAM TDI for trivalent chromium 300 µg/kg bw per day (Section 3.10, p. 10)
Combined chromium intake with novel food: 9.9 (children 3 to 9), 6.9 (adolescents), 3.9 (adults) µg/kg bw per day; 3.3%, 2.3%, 1.3% of TDI (Table 5, p. 9)
Mean chronic dietary trivalent chromium exposure 0.6 to 5.9 µg/kg bw per day; P95 1.1 to 7.9 (Section 3.7.3, p. 9)
non_numeric_findings: Essential function of trivalent chromium not substantiated; no average requirement, population reference intake or adequate intake set (p. 10).
Food is generally a reducing medium; no oxidation of trivalent to hexavalent chromium expected in food (p. 6).
